verdict.rationale: An in-browser collaboration and devtools toolbar is a fair question for a deployment platform, but the evidence pack never mentions one. Deploy Previews (netlify-docs-25) and shareable preview environments (netlify-docs-19) exist, but nothing shows on-page feedback, feature-flag management, or in-browser performance inspection. Performance tracking (netlify-docs-17) is described only at the deployment and analytics level, not as a toolbar on the live site.
